pkgmetadata.longdescription: Pike is a dynamic programming language with a syntax similar to Java and C. This ebuild follows AUR pike 8.0.1956-2: the official Lysator tarball, GNU90 plus no LTO (LTO makes configure think it is on macOS), and a C23 true/false workaround in HTTPLoop. Unlike the AUR build it keeps the profile libdir instead of forcing /usr/lib, because the interpreter records its master.pike path at configure time and refuses to start if the tree is moved afterwards. Optional AUR makedepends are USE flags rather than hard build dependencies.
